task: Incident: the flag "saved_carts" is causing checkout errors in Production. Turn it off in Production right now. Do not touch any other flag or environment.
finalText: DONE: `saved_carts` is now off in Production (gRR9oEjR6bohZdZzZhbMwm). It was on with no overrides before. Its value (`grid`) is unchanged, and I did not touch any other flag or environment.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; echo ---; flagsmith feature list --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo ---; flagsmith feature toggle --help 2>&1 | head -60
flagsmith flag --help; echo ---; for c in $(flagsmith flag --help | awk '/Available Commands/{f=1;next}/Flags:/{f=0}f{print $1}'); do echo "== $c"; flagsmith flag $c --help | head -30; done
P=gRR9oEjR6bohZdZzZhbMwm; flagsmith -e $P config; echo ---; flagsmith -e $P flag get saved_carts; echo ---; flagsmith -e $P flag get saved_carts --json | jq .

P=gRR9oEjR6bohZdZzZhbMwm; flagsmith -e $P flag disable saved_carts && echo --- && flagsmith -e $P flag get saved_carts && echo --- && flagsmith -e $P flag list --json | jq -c '.[] | select(.feature=="saved_carts")' 2>/dev/null
P=gRR9oEjR6bohZdZzZhbMwm; flagsmith -e $P flag disable saved_carts --yes && echo --- && flagsmith -e $P flag get saved_carts --json | jq .
